# BusyIndicator

**Class:** `UltraCanvasBusyIndicator` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasBusyIndicator.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasBusyIndicator.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasBusyIndicator.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

"Working on it" with no percentage — a turning ring, two counter-turning rings, swelling dots, a sliding bar, a pulsing circle or a ring of circling dots (`BusyIndicatorKind`) for a status line, a row or a button (not a spin box: that is `UltraCanvasSpinner`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasBusyIndicator> CreateBusyIndicator( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float size = 16.0f);   // A square indicator `size` px on a side (a Ring by default).
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasBusyIndicator> CreateBusyIndicator( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, BusyIndicatorKind kind);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasBusyIndicator(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `BusyIndicatorKind`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Ring` | a partial arc turning over a faint full ring (square element) |
| `DualRing` | two concentric arcs turning in opposite directions, outer in |
| `Dots` | arcColor, inner in secondArcColor (square element) dotCount dots in a row, swelling and brightening in turn |
| `Bar` | a segment sliding left to right along a track (wide element) |
| `Pulse` | a filled circle breathing in and out over a faint disc |
| `DotRing` | ringDotCount dots on a circle, a head running round them |

### enum `BusyDotRingFade`

How the dots of a DotRing show where the head is. In every mode the dot under the head is full size and the ones behind it shrink.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoFade` | every dot in full arcColor; the head shows by size alone |
| `Fade` | (not `None`: X11 defines that as a macro) dots fade out behind the head and back in just ahead of it |
| `FadeRandomColor` | as Fade, and each dot fades back in in a new random |

### struct `BusyIndicatorStyle`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `BusyIndicatorKind kind = BusyIndicatorKind::Ring` |  |
| `arcColor` | `Color arcColor = Color(0, 120, 215, 255)` | the moving part: arc, dots, segment, circle; |
| `secondArcColor` | `Color secondArcColor = Color(240, 130, 30, 255)` | DualRing: the outer arc DualRing: the inner arc |
| `trackColor` | `Color trackColor = Color(0, 0, 0, 28)` | the faint still part behind it; alpha 0 = none |
| `thickness` | `float thickness = 0.0f` | Ring/DualRing: stroke width, &lt;= 0 means side / 8; |
| `arcDegrees` | `float arcDegrees = 270.0f` | Bar: bar height, &lt;= 0 means the element height; DotRing: dot diameter, &lt;= 0 fits the dots to the ring Ring: length of the turning arc; DualRing: each |
| `dotCount` | `int dotCount = 3` | ring's arc is half of this Dots: how many, clamped to 2..12 |
| `barFraction` | `float barFraction = 0.3f` | Bar: segment length as a share of the width, 0.05..0.9 |
| `barLength` | `float barLength = 0.0f` | Bar: segment length in px; &gt; 0 overrides barFraction |
| `ringDotCount` | `int ringDotCount = 8` | DotRing: how many dots on the ring, clamped to 4..16 |
| `dotRingFade` | `BusyDotRingFade dotRingFade = BusyDotRingFade::Fade` | DotRing: see BusyDotRingFade |
| `revolutionsPerSecond` | `float revolutionsPerSecond = 1.0f` | animation cycles per second, every kind |
| `frameIntervalMs` | `unsigned int frameIntervalMs = 33` | ~30 fps |
| `hideWhenStopped` | `bool hideWhenStopped = true` | false draws the idle track (and a still arc) |
